verses.gurmukhi: ਨਵਨ ਗਵਨ ਜਲ ਸੀਤਲ ਅ ਮਲ ਜੈਸੇ ਅਗਨਿ ਉਰਧ ਮੁਖ ਤਪਤ ਮਲੀਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: navan gavan jal seetal a mal jaise agan uradh mukh tapat maleen hai ||

en.bdb: Just as water flowing downward remains cool and clear of contamination but fire that goes upward causes heat and pollution;

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਹੁਇ ਆਂਬ ਝੁਕੇ ਰਹਤ ਹੈ ਚਿਰੰਕਾਲ ਨਿਵੈ ਨ ਅਰਿੰਡ ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਆਰਬਲਾ ਛੀਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: safal hui aa(n)b jhuke rahat hai chira(n)kaal nivai na ari(n)dd taa(n) te aarabalaa chheen hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a mango tree bends down when it yields fruit, and lives a long life, but a castor oil seed plant does not bend. It would break if we bend it, it breaks. Thus it has a short span of life.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਸੀਐ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਬਾਂਸ ਤਉ ਬਡਾਈ ਬੂਡਿਓ ਸੰਗ ਲਿਵਲੀਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dhan subaas jaise baaseeaai banaasapatee baa(n)s tau baddaiee booddio sa(n)g livaleen hai ||

en.bdb: Just as the sweet smell of a small sized sandalwood tree gets infused in the vegetation around it, but a tall and high bamboo plant arrogant of its size absorbs no fragrance of the sandalwood tree.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਨਿਮ੍ਰਤਾ ਕੈ ਸਨ ਅਉ ਮਜੀਠ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਕੀਨ ਹੈ ॥੩੦੬॥
verses.translit_en: taise hee asaadh saadh aha(n)budh nimrataa kai san aau majeeTh gat paap pu(n)n keen hai ||306||

en.bdb: Similarly evil and apostate people bound by their pride and ego commit sins. On the contrary those good people who live in the way of the Guru and are humble, do good work like Rubia munjista (Majith). (306)
